blocks.text: PHOENIX — Devin Booker scored 30 points, Dillon Brooks added 24 and the Phoenix Suns snapped a four-game losing streak by beating the Orlando Magic 117-104 on Thursday night. The Suns won a night after falling at home to Portland. The Magic have dropped three straight. READ: Booker and Brooks hit back-to-back 3s midway through the third quarter to extend the Suns’ lead to 78-60 and they pushed that advantage to 96-73 heading into the fourth. Collin Gillespie’s 3-pointer with 9:20 left gave the Suns a 30-point lead, which was the largest of the night. Miles Bridges added 18 points and […]...
